title: Prr. Scratch my head. Prr.
html_source: As part of the same paragraph as Mr Bloom’s thoughts, this seems to be also his own thoughts. Mr Bloom seems to be narrating the cats thoughts and actions, but he says “my”, relating to the cats head, suggesting a sense of identification, as he imagines what her life is like from her perspective.
